component.name: PollTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "poll" end sub
sub poll() http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetMinimumTransferRate(1, 45) ' give up on a silent connection after 45s (server waits 25s) seen = "" while true http.SetUrl(m.top.server + "/api/display?seen=" + seen) body = http.GetToString() data = invalid if body <> "" then data = ParseJson(body) if data = invalid or data.token = invalid sleep(3000) ' server down or restarting: try again shortly else if data.token <> seen then m.top.display = data seen = data.token end if end while end sub
